svg.title: Prevention months are not on the federal Lyme community list
svg.desc: A calendar-style chart for regions that appear on the Public Health Agency of Canada Lyme risk community list. Months are labelled ask your veterinarian because the federal page does not publish a season.
svg.text: Prevention months: not on the PHAC list
Typical months were not published. Ask your veterinarian. Communities below are examples from the list, not a complete map.

g.text: Your municipality, if it is on the list
Search the PHAC page, then ask your vet.

svg.text: Lyme risk areas are not the same decision as heartworm prevention. The OVMA 2025 adult test line is 125 dollars.
No product price was opened, so this chart has no dollar bars. Monthly cost is dose price times the months your veterinarian names.
Saving Optimizer, 26 Sep 2026. Labelled typical only in the sense that months must be confirmed. None are invented.
